---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea, a system, or an asset for the game
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**What would you like to see?**
A clear description of the feature.

**Why? (player experience / what it adds)**
Who benefits and how — gameplay depth, performance, compatibility, fun?

**Scope sketch**
Which part of the build would it touch (`s01`…`s26`, listed in CONTRIBUTING.md)?
Does it need new assets (models/textures/audio)? Rough size?

**Are you able to contribute it?**
- [ ] Yes, I can implement it
- [ ] Maybe, with guidance
- [ ] Just an idea — someone else please pick it up

**Alternatives considered**
Any simpler/other ways to get the same result.

**Anything else**
Mockups, links, references, examples from other games.
